case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

We have reviewed your offer and hold our Angebot. Having already accommodated the 24-month term and the later start date, we must maintain our current offer of €51.50 per unit. Therefore, our current offer stands at a price of €51.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027. Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days.

Our family foundry takes great pride in the quality of work our skilled people deliver day after day. We trust you understand our position, and we look forward to continuing our trusted partnership on these fair terms.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
